partialSourceArtifactDiskForecast.scope: Sequential retained outputs are summed for disk, unlike maximum-phase RAM. Uses the same census growth ratio on complete baseline graph/qualification/native, rebuild and cut directories plus measured new merge/preparation. Existing raw caches/tool images and all historical data remain in place and are excluded from incremental additions. This is a partial-source heuristic, not a reservation/bound for missing-source full six-hour coverage or arbitrary failed retries.

scope: Physical host memory and Docker VM capacity are distinct from the per-container 4 GiB/no-swap cap. Host/VM paging and full missing-region demand remain unmeasured; source-merge whole-phase memory is included separately and is below the forecast maximum.
